description: This file defines API route handlers for managing test suites, including CRUD operations and execution triggers, using Express router and Swagger annotations.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all test suites.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new test suite.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch details of a specific test suite by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing test suite.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a test suite.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Handles POST requests to trigger execution of a test suite.
